These files were generated by https://github.com/B3n30/citra_system_archives at git commit 0baa5f5773432f04e3e671859780ded965c4248c. To generate the files use the run.sh inside that repository

The follwing system archives are currently included:
 - JPN/EUR/USA System Font
 - NG Bad Word List

Azahar CJK Fallback is generated from the vendored Unifont 13.0.06 (OFL-1.1).
Rebuild with tools/shared_font/generate_cjk.py. Provenance, character ranges and hashes are in include/cjk_font.manifest.json.
It covers common BMP Chinese ideographs, kana, Bopomofo, Latin and symbols; it is not a complete Unicode font.
